 Exeter Festival of Beer 2027 dates and tickets confirmed

 Visitors at the previous Exeter Festival of Beer at the Corn Exchange, photographed in January 2026. (Image: Submitted) 
 This article is brought to you by our exclusive subscriber partnership with our sister title USA Today,
 and has been written by our American colleagues.
 It does not necessarily reflect the view of The Herald.
 A city beer festival will offer alcohol-free and low-alcohol drinks for the first time as organisers confirm dates and ticket arrangements for its return.
 Exeter Festival of Beer is taking place at the Corn Exchange from Thursday, January 14, to Saturday, January 16, 2027, organised by the Exeter and East Devon branch of the Campaign for Real Ale (CAMRA).
 Read more

 Exeter CAMRA 2025 Beer Festival: Full date and times announced 
 Steins and sausages as nine-day Oktoberfest takes over award-winning bar 
 It will run from 4pm to 10pm on Thursday and 11am to 10pm on Friday and Saturday. Entry to the Friday 11am-to-4pm session will be by advance ticket only, although tickets can be purchased at the door for other sessions, subject to arrangements.
 Organisers plan to offer around 66 real ales, ten ciders and perries, and four extra casks of popular beers. A trial range of zero- and low-alcohol beers and cider will also be offered.
 The festival moved to the Corn Exchange in 2023 and has been staged in Exeter for 37 years.
 Three ticketed tasting sessions are planned. Beer writer Tim Webb will present sessions on “Proper Lagers” and “Historic and Excellent Brown Ales”, while Ben Gray of Gray's Devon Cider will lead “Meet the Cider Maker”. The sessions carry an additional charge.
 A CAMRA spokesperson said: “We are really excited to be able to return for a fifth year at the Exeter Corn Exchange. The venue has been well-received by those who attended in previous years and we look forward to welcoming familiar faces and those who are attending for the first time, for what we hope will continue to be a festival with a very friendly atmosphere. We would also like to thank all our sponsors and supporters who help make this event possible.”
 The festival will support Hospiscare. Further information and advance tickets will be available from the Exeter and East Devon CAMRA website .
